content:
sara-support: FYI escalating a customer-facing bug: when they call two tools in parallel via function-calling, tool_result association is sometimes swapped between calls and they get duplicate billing + an auth failure for the second tool. Happening intermittently across regions. Customer id: acct_8472. Request IDs included below.

maria-cs: ugh, any repro steps? they need a clear repro we can run. :thinking_face:

sara-support: Repro is easy to trigger for them. payload pattern: they call two tools at once: get_profile and charge_card. Example (simplified):
```json
POST /v1/respond
{
  "input": "charge workflow",
  "tools": ["get_profile","charge_card"],
  "parallel": true,
  "trace": true
}
```
Server logs show tool_result mapping like: sometimes charge_card result is returned under get_profile key. Also saw schema validation errors from the charge_card tool: expected number for amount but got string; that error occasionally appears attached to wrong tool in the agent response.

jamie-eng: Can you paste one of the raw request IDs and matching internal traces? Need the call_id/correlation_id to scan logs. :eyes:

sara-support: Request IDs: rq_20260317_001 and rq_20260317_002. Internal span ids: span-7f2 and span-7f4. Hooking trace to this thread. Also attaching a short excerpt of the internal debug log (redacted):

```
[2026-03-17T14:22:10.123Z] rq_20260317_001 call_map_insert key=tool|get_profile correlation=cid-42 -> pending
[2026-03-17T14:22:10.125Z] rq_20260317_001 tool_result_insert key=tool|charge_card correlation=cid-42 -> success {tx:ch_9xx, amount:"100"}
[2026-03-17T14:22:10.126Z] rq_20260317_001 finalize_map mapping[tool|get_profile] = {tx:ch_9xx, amount:"100"}
[2026-03-17T14:22:10.127Z] rq_20260317_001 validation_error tool=get_profile schema: expected integer for amount
```

nate-sre: That log snippet screams correlation id reuse. correlation=cid-42 is reused for both tool slots. If the map is keyed by correlation id instead of a per-invocation unique token, parallel writes can race. Might be an allocator bug in the multi_tool_use wrapper.

leo-ml: Adding :bug: I dug into multi_tool_use wrapper (recent change in 2026-02). The helper was changed to set correlation_id = session_id for ease of debugging; session_id is reused for concurrent ops. That explains the swaps. Suggested fix: generate a per-tool UUID (trace-unique) when spawning parallel tool calls and use that as map key. I'm prepping a small patch.

jamie-eng: Good catch. Two questions: 1) Why are we also seeing schema validation errors attached to wrong tool names? 2) Billing duplicate charges — is charge_card being executed twice or just reported twice?

sara-support: From customer traces, charge processing hit the payment gateway twice for 3 of 12 attempts last week. So real double-charges, not just reporting. The gateway confirms two separate POSTs with different tx ids (one of which was rolled back by us when we noticed). Customer is unhappy and wants refunds.

nate-sre: For root cause: if the same correlation id points to multiple tool futures, completion callbacks may pick up the wrong slot and fire the tool handler twice. Race + wrong mapping = duplicate invocation. The auth failure case looks like when a tool's creds are not found because the handler reads creds for the other tool. So the mapping bug cascades into auth and schema layers.

maria-cs: We need immediate mitigation recommendations for the customer while eng works on a fix. They asked whether switching to sequential calls would help.

leo-ml: Short-term mitigations: 1) Ask customer to set parallel=false (sequential) — this prevents races. 2) They can include an explicit per-tool call_id in the tool args (we will honor call_id if provided) which avoids relying on correlation. 3) Enable request-level dedupe on charge endpoint (idempotency_key) until patch deployed.

sara-support: Provided those recommendations, customer turned on idempotency_key and set parallel=false. They confirmed no duplicates after change, but it's a pain. Customer requested a timeline for a proper fix + a postmortem and refund guidance.

jamie-eng: Action items: 1) leo to open PR to generate per-tool UUID keys and add unit tests around concurrent tool_map insert/finalize. 2) nate to run a controlled load test and replay customer request ids to confirm no duplicates after patch. 3) support to coordinate refunds case by case; billing to be cc'd. 4) add a feature-flag gate to disable multi-tool parallel mapping until next deploy.

leo-ml: PR opened: https://redwood.internal/changes/RI-4521 . Patch includes: unique correlation for each tool, strict map ownership in finalize, and additional trace logs. Plan: hotfix branch -> canary -> full rollout. ETA for canary: 24 hrs.

nate-sre: I'll schedule the canary tonight and run replay against sandbox payments. Will post results here.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: hotfix/RI-4521 -> canary (env=us-east-1) by leo-ml at 2026-03-17T20:10:00Z :rocket:

maria-cs: Thanks team. Support will open a formal refund ticket for acct_8472 and send the customer the workaround steps + timeline. Please ping when canary passes. :pray:

sara-support: Closing loop: add a postmortem note to incidents channel after deploy. I'll include customer impact details and refund status.

jamie-eng: Also add a unit test that simulates malformed args (amount as string) in parallel invocations to guard the validation layer. We should assert validation errors are bound to correct tool keys.

leo-ml: Will do. I'll also add a migration task to scan logs for prior correlation_id reuse patterns and notify any customers affected.

maria-cs: Good. Marking this as high-priority support escalation. Thanks everyone.
